meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 issue 和外部 PR 分门别类、核实、必要时深挖,产出可直接派活的简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的仓库堆积大量 issue 和外部 PR,需要固定流程来分拣和处理
copy.tagline_en: Sort issues and outside PRs, verify them, and turn them into dispatch-ready briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your repo gets a flood of issues and outside PRs and you need a steady way to sort and route them

howto.what: 把 issue 和外部 PR 沿一套分类角色与状态角色逐步推进：先给出分类与状态建议，验证说法、必要时逐条追问，最后贴出 agent 可直接执行的任务简报。
howto.when: 由维护者手动输入 /triage 并说明需求时接管，比如查看待处理项或推进某个 issue、PR；它不会被模型自动调用。

say.text: 看看有哪些需要我处理的 issue 和外部 PR
say.note: 按未分类、待评估、待补充信息三组列出
确认角色变更后直接应用
读全文和代码库，给出分类与状态建议

howto.what_en: Moves issues and external PRs through category and state roles: recommends a category and state, verifies the claim, grills if needed, and posts an agent-ready brief. Triage comments are labelled AI-generated.
howto.when_en: Invoked manually by the maintainer via /triage with a natural-language request, such as reviewing what needs attention or moving a named issue or PR. It is not auto-invoked by the model.

say_en.text: Show me anything that needs my attention
say_en.note: Lists unlabeled, needs-triage, and needs-info items
Confirms the role change, then applies it
Gathers context, then recommends a category and state
